meta.title: Archify architecture diagrams
meta.description:
Creates validated architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, lifecycle/state, ERD, class, tree, timeline, and waterfall diagrams as explorable standalone HTML files with dark/light themes, motion, and image/SVG/WebM export. Accepts a requirements description or Mermaid source, and can inspect repository evidence for code-backed diagrams.

Usage: ask the agent in any session, for example "Use the archify skill to map this repository's runtime architecture". Generated JSON and HTML are ordinary workspace files — ask the agent for their exact paths and open the HTML in a browser; shell-created files do not appear in the Produced Files strip automatically.

Notes: the bundled skill includes an optional, notification-only update check (set ARCHIFY_UPDATE_CHECK_DISABLED=1 to disable it) and may fetch pinned remote brand assets; the adapter itself makes no network requests and adds no telemetry. Disabling this bundle removes the archify skill from sessions.
